## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Running `make test` produces `0 warnings` (currently `2 warnings`)
- [ ] The fix uses a test-scoped `filterwarnings` ignore (either in `pyproject.toml` or via `@pytest.mark.filterwarnings` on the spawn tests in `tests/test_terminals.py`)
- [ ] The filter targets only the specific `DeprecationWarning` from `pty` about `forkpty()` in multi-threaded processes — not a blanket suppression of all `DeprecationWarning`
- [ ] The spawn implementation in `src/decafclaw/terminals.py` remains unchanged (no `warnings.catch_warnings()` wrapper, no changes to the `pty.fork()` call or its surrounding logic)
- [ ] The comment at `terminals.py:71-73` documenting the deliberate decision remains intact
- [ ] `pytest` still surfaces other `DeprecationWarning` instances that are not this specific `forkpty` warning
